trakt_popular_shows.description: London police officer DC Hana Li is escorting Dr Matthew Nolan back to Beijing where he has been accused of a crime. However, on board flight 357, she finds herself embroiled in an escalating conspiracy and a growing number of murders.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Below Deck Down Under
trakt_popular_shows.description: Set against the stunning backdrop of the tropical Whitsunday Islands and world-famous Great Barrier Reef in northeastern Australia, this series explores the complex, often explosive dynamics of the crew and a rotating group of demanding charter guests on M/Y Thalassa.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Dark Winds
trakt_popular_shows.description: This psychological thriller follows two Navajo police officers, Leaphorn and Chee, in the 1970s Southwest as their search for clues in a grisly double murder case forces them to challenge their own spiritual beliefs and come to terms with the trauma of their pasts.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Prisoner
trakt_popular_shows.description: A young and ambitious prison officer finds herself in the middle of a battle for the criminal underworld as crime lords try to evade justice. But in order to do that, she will have to learn quickly to put her faith in one of the very men she wants to put behind bars.

trakt_popular_shows.name: For All Mankind
trakt_popular_shows.description: Explore an aspirational world where NASA and the space program remained a priority and a focal point of our hopes and dreams as told through the lives of NASA astronauts, engineers, and their families.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Death of the Pastor's Wife
trakt_popular_shows.description: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Outer Banks
trakt_popular_shows.description: On a North Carolina island of haves and have-nots, John B and his tight-knit crew of friends find mystery and adventure while hunting for lost treasure.

trakt_popular_shows.description: After a plane crash, a group of schoolboys find themselves stranded on a tropical island without adults. Jack, responsible for the signal fire, becomes increasingly focused on hunting and power struggles. This leads to tensions within the group, gradually pushing the boys from hope and structure into chaos and tragedy.

trakt_popular_shows.description: Begoña Montes is a woman who lives trapped in a toxic marriage and seeks the long-awaited freedom in Spain in 1958.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Bait
trakt_popular_shows.description: Shah Latif is a struggling actor on the cusp of landing the role of a lifetime, only to find himself thrust into a full blown existential crisis and trippy conspiracy thriller all at the same time.

Amid repeated commutes, accidents at work, and failed relationships, the two become each other's irreplaceable anchor.

He uses his skill to find the best hidden talents in the world to make their small, weak domain into the best.

And the story of the Xs being brutally crushed by her.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Worst Neighbor Ever
trakt_popular_shows.description: This intense documentary series details true stories of neighbors gone bad, from heinous fraud schemes to senseless acts of violent retribution.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Death by Lightning

trakt_popular_shows.name: AMERICA'S SWEETHEARTS: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders
trakt_popular_shows.description: Follow the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders from auditions to training camp and the NFL season as they chase their dreams and a coveted spot on the squad.

trakt_popular_shows.name: WWE: Unreal
trakt_popular_shows.description: From Monday Night RAW to WrestleMania, this series goes backstage with WWE Superstars and staff as they bring the company's biggest spectacles to life.

He finds out that the only girlfriend he ever had, in middle school, Hinata Tachibana, had been killed by the ruthless Tokyo Manji Gang. The day after hearing about her death, he’s standing on the station platform and ends up being pushed over onto the tracks by a herd of people. He closes his eyes thinking he’s about to die, but when he opens his eyes back up, he somehow had gone back in time 12 years. Now that he’s back living the best days of his life, Takemichi decides to get revenge on his life.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Paris Has Fallen
trakt_popular_shows.description: A protection officer and an MI6 operative team up after a terrorist attack. They suspect a mole as they race to thwart a larger conspiracy threatening Paris.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Asset

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Last Thing He Told Me
trakt_popular_shows.description: A woman must forge a relationship with her teenage stepdaughter in order to find her husband, who has mysteriously disappeared.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Rulers of Fortune

trakt_popular_shows.description: One fateful day, all of humanity was petrified by a blinding flash of light. After several millennia, high schooler Taiju awakens and finds himself lost in a world of statues. However, he’s not alone! His science-loving friend Senku’s been up and running for a few months and he's got a grand plan in mind—to kickstart civilization with the power of science!

trakt_popular_shows.name: Euphoria
trakt_popular_shows.description: A group of high school students navigate love and friendships in a world of drugs, sex, trauma, and social media.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Idol I
trakt_popular_shows.description: Maeng Se-na, a top star criminal lawyer who has been a fangirl for fifteen years, tries to prove her favorite idol’s innocence, who is suspected of murder.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Mike Judge's Beavis and Butt-Head
trakt_popular_shows.description: Two teenage heavy-metal music fans occasionally do idiotic things because they're bored. For them, everything is "cool" or "sucks."

trakt_popular_shows.name: Perfect Match
trakt_popular_shows.description: Couples who prove their compatibility gain the power to make or break other matches in this strategic and seductive dating competition.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Outlast: The Jungle
trakt_popular_shows.description: On a remote tropical island, 16 players must survive the elements, outmaneuver rivals and remain part of a team for a chance to win a $1 million prize.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Reality Check: Inside America's Next Top Model
trakt_popular_shows.description: What started as a glamorous launchpad for aspiring models became a pop-culture juggernaut defined by explosive drama, public meltdowns, and controversies that still fuel viral moments today.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Ripple
trakt_popular_shows.description: In New York City, four strangers navigate life's challenges while their separate paths unexpectedly intertwine in ways that change them forever.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Power Book III: Raising Kanan
trakt_popular_shows.description: Set in South Jamaica, Queens, in 1991, this prequel to "Power" revolves around the coming of age of Kanan Stark.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Monster of Florence
trakt_popular_shows.description: As a serial killer targets couples and strikes terror in Italy, authorities explore a case from 1968 that may be key to finding The Monster of Florence.

trakt_popular_shows.name: A Shop for Killers
trakt_popular_shows.description: A niece who lost her parents and grew up in the hands of an uncle who runs a shopping mall faces a new truth after her uncle's sudden death.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Record of Ragnarok
trakt_popular_shows.description: Before eradicating humankind from the world, the gods give them one last chance to prove themselves worthy of survival. Let the Ragnarok battles begin.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Human Vapor
trakt_popular_shows.description: A death on live TV. A culprit who turns to gas. Behind it, a secret project that used and discarded the vulnerable. One detective pursues the dark truth.

trakt_popular_shows.name: My Brilliant Career
trakt_popular_shows.description: Restless, razor-sharp and refusing to conform, 17-year-old Sybylla Melvyn is dead set on writing her own story in an era that expects her to find a man and settle down.

Explore the high-pressure experiences of police officers, paramedics and firefighters who are thrust into the most frightening, shocking and heart-stopping situations. These emergency responders must try to balance saving those who are at their most vulnerable with solving the problems in their own lives.
A zany nobleman contends with family feuds and clashes with peasants in his quest to become the most famous person in Poland.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Bel-Air
trakt_popular_shows.description: The journey of a book smart teen whose life is forever transformed when he moves from the streets of west Philadelphia to live with his relatives in one of LA’s wealthiest suburbs.

trakt_popular_shows.name: In the Mud
trakt_popular_shows.description: Five female prisoners forge a unique bond after a deadly accident... until corruption and turf wars within a ruthless prison threaten to destroy them.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The House of the Spirits
trakt_popular_shows.description: The epic tale of a proud and passionate family, secret loves, and bloody revolution. The Trueba family's passions, struggles, and secrets span a century of violent social change, culminating in a crisis that hurls the proud, tyrannical patriarch and his beloved granddaughter towards opposite sides of the fence.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Heartbreak High
trakt_popular_shows.description: A fresh look at Hartley High over 20 years on. With her new friends - outsiders Quinni and Darren - Amerie must repair her reputation, while navigating love, sex, and heartbreak.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Flunked
trakt_popular_shows.description: Eddy, a math genius and small-time crook, avoids jail-time by going undercover as a teacher. His mission: to identify the kid of a major criminal.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Michael Jackson: The Verdict
trakt_popular_shows.description: Told by key players who were inside the courtroom, this comprehensive documentary dissects the trial of Michael Jackson and his complex legacy.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Tremembé
trakt_popular_shows.description: The arrival of Suzane Von Richthofen shakes Tremembé's order, sparking a power struggle with Elize Matsunaga. Jatobá seeks protection, while Nardoni, the Cravinhos brothers, Roger A. and others face internal clashes and defy the system.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Sandokan
trakt_popular_shows.description: Sandokan is a Malaysian pirate who, along with his friend Yanez and their crew, attacks the British forces from his island of Mompracem. During his adventures, he falls in love with Lady Marianna Guillonk, an English-Italian aristocrat.

trakt_popular_shows.name: As You Stood By
trakt_popular_shows.description: When two women plot to end an abusive marriage through murder, an unexpected visitor arrives — threatening to shatter everything they've carefully planned.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Perfect Lie
trakt_popular_shows.description: When one of their own is killed in a house fire, four picture-perfect couples are forced to question everything they thought they knew about each other.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Would You Marry Me?
trakt_popular_shows.description: A couple who pretend to be newlyweds, find themselves developing genuine feelings for each other as they navigate their fake marriage.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Witness
trakt_popular_shows.description: With their 2-year-old as the sole witness to her murder, Rachel Nickell's partner fights to protect him amid a flawed investigation.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Duang with You
trakt_popular_shows.description: After a festival confession, art student Duang sets out to win over a guarded music major, slowly turning first love into a safe haven for them both.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Chained Soldier
trakt_popular_shows.description: Destructive monsters from the Mato dimension threaten the earth, while women gifted with powers from Peaches try to stop them. But to save the world, Yuuki must be willing to become Chief Kyoka's servant both on the battlefield and at home.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Next Level Chef
trakt_popular_shows.description: The next evolution in cooking competitions, as Gordon Ramsay has designed a one-of-a-kind culinary gauntlet, set on an iconic stage over three stories high, each floor contains a stunningly different kitchen. From the glistening top floor to the challenging bottom of the basement, the ingredients match the environment, because Ramsay believes the true test of great chefs is not only what they can do in the best of circumstances, but what kind of magic they can create in the worst!

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Map of Longing
trakt_popular_shows.description: Before her death, Lucy creates a game for her sister, Greta, pushing her into a journey of self-discovery — and toward the charming Will Tucker.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Elusive Samurai
trakt_popular_shows.description: Set between the Kamakura and Muromachi periods, during the Kenmu Restoration, the story follows the tale of Hojo Tokiyuki, a boy on the run after his family is overthrown by Ashikaga Takauji. With his only allies being a shady priest and his followers, the young lord must seek revenge and regain his glory, with his only weapon: a superhuman ability to flee and hide.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26
trakt_popular_shows.description: Six studios and seven directors adapt the early works of Tatsuki Fujimoto, the mastermind behind "Chainsaw Man," into an anime anthology. Each episode is an anime adaptation of a short story he drew from ages seventeen to twenty-six, including the first manga he ever submitted for competition. Watch as vivid tales of young love, chaos, madness, and the bonds between people unfold in each episode.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You
trakt_popular_shows.description: Rentaro Aijo was rejected 100 times in middle school. He visits a shrine and prays for better luck in high school. The God of Love appears and promises that he'll soon meet 100 people he's destined to date. But there's a catch—once destiny introduces someone to him, the two must happily love each other. If they don't, they'll die. What will befall Rentaro and his 100 girlfriends in high school?

trakt_popular_shows.name: Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill
trakt_popular_shows.description: Tsuyoshi Mukohda, an ordinary salaryman, is suddenly transported to another world one day. The unique skill he gains upon arrival in this world is the seemingly useless "Online Grocery." Mukohda is discouraged at first, but the modern foods he's able to bring to his new world using this skill prove to have some unbelievable effects!

trakt_popular_shows.name: Innate
trakt_popular_shows.description: A psychologist is forced to confront her past when a new series of murders echoes the crimes that put her serial killer father behind bars 25 years ago.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Colin from Accounts
trakt_popular_shows.description: Ashley and Gordon are two single(ish), complex humans who are brought together by a car accident and an injured dog. Flawed, funny people choosing each other and being brave enough to show their true self, scars and all, as they navigate life together.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Gangs of Galicia
trakt_popular_shows.description: When her father's murder reveals a hidden double life, a lawyer seeks revenge by infiltrating a Galician drug cartel and becoming close to its leader.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Worst Ex Ever
trakt_popular_shows.description: From chilling betrayals to murder plots, this true-crime docuseries dissects the dark side of love through eyewitness testimonies.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Should I Marry a Murderer?
trakt_popular_shows.description: In 2020, pathologist Caroline Muirhead's fiancé, Scottish farmer Alexander 'Sandy' McKellar, confessed to her that he and his twin brother Robert had killed cyclist Tony Parsons in a 2017 hit-and-run on the A82 near Bridge of Orchy and buried the body on the Auch Estate.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Shoresy
trakt_popular_shows.description: Foul-mouthed, chirp-serving, mother-loving, fan favourite character, Shoresy, joins the Sudbury Bulldogs of the Northern Ontario Senior Hockey Organization (The NOSHO) on a quest to never lose again.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Lead Children
trakt_popular_shows.description: When a young doctor discovers that children living near a smelting plant suffer from lead poisoning, she risks her career and safety to save them.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Star Wars: Visions
trakt_popular_shows.description: This anthology of animated shorts from around the world celebrates the mythos of Star Wars through unique cultural lenses.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Law According to Lidia Poët
trakt_popular_shows.description: In late 19th-century Turin, young Lidia Poët fights against everything and everyone to get what is rightfully hers: to be enrolled in the official register of lawyers; a profession, at the time, reserved exclusively for men. Nevertheless, nothing could stop her dream of becoming the first female lawyer in Italy.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Fake Profile
trakt_popular_shows.description: Camila meets her Prince Charming through a dating app. After an idyllic romance, she plans to surprise him — only to end up trapped in a false paradise.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Accident
trakt_popular_shows.description: When a birthday party takes a tragic turn, its ripples shatter a close-knit community — tearing families, friendships and hearts apart.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Boyfriend
trakt_popular_shows.description: Over the course of a month, a group of men live under one roof and run a coffee truck together to connect and hopefully meet their one true boyfriend.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Naughty Business
trakt_popular_shows.description: When her husband falls into a coma, Nines, a traditional housewife, transforms the family business into the first adult video store in Valladolid.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Furies
trakt_popular_shows.description: Seeking to avenge her father's death, a young woman becomes entangled in the web of the Fury, peacekeeper of the Paris criminal underworld.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Stranger Things
trakt_popular_shows.description: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Way Home
trakt_popular_shows.description: When three generations of women reunite after being estranged for more than two decades, they embark on an enlightening – and surprising – journey toward healing none of them could have imagined as they learn how to find their way back to each other.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Love Island USA
trakt_popular_shows.description: The matchmaking begins as a group of single "Islanders" come together in a stunning villa on a beautiful tropical island, ready to embark on a summer of dating, romance, and ultimately, relationships. Every few days the Islanders pair up and those who are not coupled are at risk of being dumped from the island. Islanders are on the lookout for romance, but the road to love doesn't always run smoothly.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Formula 1: Drive to Survive
trakt_popular_shows.description: Drivers, managers and team owners live life in the fast lane — both on and off the track — during each cutthroat season of Formula 1 racing.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Rafa
trakt_popular_shows.description: RAFA retraces Nadal's remarkable journey with cinematic scope, combining testimonies from those who know him best—on and off the court—with unseen moments that reveal what lies behind the legend.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Entrepreneurs
trakt_popular_shows.description: Gonzalo, a bar owner's son, keeps failing at nightlife ventures funded by his father. Given one last chance with a new space, he partners with a self-proclaimed guru to open a coworking space, supervised by his sister Julia.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Me and Thee
trakt_popular_shows.description: An introverted photographer's life changes when a former mafia boss hires him for love advice, only to end up falling for him instead.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Amazing Digital Circus
trakt_popular_shows.description: A woman finds herself trapped in a virtual circus where she and five other humans are subject to the whims of a wacky AI ringmaster. In this digital purgatory they must face frightening NPCs and cope with their own personal traumas.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Prosecutor's Proposal
trakt_popular_shows.description: A victim’s son and a killer’s son reunite as a prosecutor and investigator, fighting systemic corruption while becoming each other's salvation.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Beyond Paradise
trakt_popular_shows.description: After leaving paradise and seeking a quieter life, Humphrey has taken a job as Detective Inspector in his fiancée Martha's hometown. But with the high crime rate, maybe things will be louder than expected.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Drops of God
trakt_popular_shows.description: While the world of wine mourns the death of Alexandre Léger, his estranged daughter, Camille, learns his extraordinary collection is now hers. But before she can claim her inheritance, Camille must best Alexandre's protégé, Issei, in a test of their senses.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Medusa
trakt_popular_shows.description: Somebody wants to kill CEO Bárbara Hidalgo. Can she find the culprit as her family schemes ruthlessly for control of their Colombian business empire?

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Forsytes
trakt_popular_shows.description: Chronicles the lives of four generations of an upper-class family of stockbrokers, set against the backdrop of a rapidly evolving late-Victorian world.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Deadloch
trakt_popular_shows.description: Two vastly different female detectives are thrown together to solve the murder of a local man in the sleepy seaside hamlet of Deadloch.

trakt_popular_shows.name: La nena
trakt_popular_shows.description: Months after the events of The Purple Network, the hunt is not over yet. Following Lucas's death, Elena Blanco has disappeared. Only Mariajo knows where she is, but she keeps it a secret, even from the rest of the team. The fight against The Network has taken too much of a toll on her, and in a desperate attempt to get her life back on track, she has left the BAC.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon
trakt_popular_shows.description: A middle-aged man with only one passion in his life meets a fitting end in a traffic accident. That's where most stories would end, but instead, this is when his story begins when he's reborn as what he admired the most in life--a vending machine! But his new lease on life happens in the worst place possible--what can a vending machine do in a monster-infested dungeon when he can't speak or even move on his own?

trakt_popular_shows.name: Khemjira
trakt_popular_shows.description: With a deadly curse set to claim him at 21, a young man flees to a master of ancient magic—only to face ghosts more dangerous than his fate.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Starting 5
trakt_popular_shows.description: Follows 5 NBA players throughout an entire NBA series, delving into their on-court performance and off-court personal lives.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Homicide
trakt_popular_shows.description: Detectives and prosecutors revisit their most challenging homicide cases in this chilling true-crime docuseries.

trakt_popular_shows.name: To Your Eternity
trakt_popular_shows.description: An immortal being takes on the form of a human boy, wandering the earth and experiencing the pains and joys of life throughout his story without end.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Love on the Spectrum
trakt_popular_shows.description: In this romantic docuseries, people on the autism spectrum look for love and navigate the changing world of dating and relationships.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Payback
trakt_popular_shows.description: A grieving debt collector enters the entertainment world for revenge, only to fall into a dangerous attraction with a powerful executive.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Black Clover
trakt_popular_shows.description: Asta and Yuno are two orphans who want the same thing: to become the Wizard King. Locked in a friendly rivalry, they work hard towards their goal. While Yuno excels at magic, Asta has a problem uncommon in this world: he has no powers! But, on the day they receive their grimoires, they surprise everyone. To reach their goal, they’ll each find their own path to greatness—with or without magic.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Billy the Kid
trakt_popular_shows.description: An epic romantic adventure series based on the life of famous American outlaw Billy the Kid — from his humble Irish roots, to his early days as a cowboy and gunslinger in the American frontier, to his pivotal role in the Lincoln County War and beyond.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Fire Force
trakt_popular_shows.description: Year 198 of the Solar Era in Tokyo, special fire brigades are fighting against a phenomenon called spontaneous human combustion where humans beings are turned into living infernos called "Infernals". While the Infernals are first generation cases of spontaneous human combustion, later generations possess the ability to manipulate flames while retaining human form. Shinra Kusakabe, a youth who gained the nickname Devil's Footprints for his ability to ignite his feet at will, joins the Special Fire Force Company 8 which composes of other flames users as they work to extinguish any Infernals they encounter. As a faction that is creating Infernals appears, Shira begins to uncover the truth behind a mysterious fire that caused the death of his family twelve years ago.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Conan O'Brien Must Go
trakt_popular_shows.description: Conan O'Brien visits new friends he met through his podcast, "Conan O'Brien Needs a Fan," where he dives deep with listeners from across the country and the world.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Farming Life in Another World
trakt_popular_shows.description: After Hiraku dies of a serious illness, God brings him back to life, gives his health and youth back, and sends him to a fantasy world of his choice. In order to enjoy his second shot, God bestows upon him the almighty farming tool! Watch as Hiraku digs, chops, and ploughs in another world in this laidback farming fantasy!

trakt_popular_shows.name: Red Queen
trakt_popular_shows.description: A gifted woman's intellect brings chance to lead covert European police force. But it backfires, costing her everything. Following murder at her home and kidnapped heiress, her ex-supervisor enlists a policeman's aid to reinstate her.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Single's Inferno
trakt_popular_shows.description: On a deserted island, flirtatious singles look for love, because only as a couple can they leave the island for a romantic date in paradise.

trakt_popular_shows.name: If It's Tuesday, It's Murder
trakt_popular_shows.description: A diverse group of tourists on an organized trip to Lisbon find themselves investigating a murder after one of them is killed on the first morning.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Boss
trakt_popular_shows.description: Eliseo is the superintendent of an upscale building. On the surface, is cordial and docile in his role, but underneath Eliseo believes himself the omnipotent figure of the community — meddling in the affairs of residents and pulling strings as he sees fit. Eliseo's only concern is protecting his job, which comes under threat by a proposed pool project.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Industry
trakt_popular_shows.description: In the cutthroat world of international finance, a group of young graduates compete for a limited set of permanent positions at a top investment bank in London. The boundaries between colleague, friend, lover, and enemy soon blur as they immerse themselves in a company culture defined as much by sex, drugs and ego as it is by deals and dividends.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Survival of the Thickest
trakt_popular_shows.description: Black, plus-size and newly single, Mavis unexpectedly finds herself having to rebuild her life after putting all her eggs in one man's basket, but she's determined to not only survive but thrive with the support of her chosen family.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Sweet Magnolias
trakt_popular_shows.description: Lifelong friends Maddie, Helen and Dana Sue lift each other up as they juggle relationships, family and careers in the small Southern town of Serenity.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Tribute
trakt_popular_shows.description: The story follows Adolfo Novak, a powerful family patriarch, whose 80th birthday celebration uncovers decades of secrets, betrayals, loyalties, and a thirst for revenge.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Heweliusz
trakt_popular_shows.description: After a catastrophic ferry disaster, the off-duty captain seeks answers and justice for those who lost their lives — and those they left behind.

trakt_popular_shows.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
trakt_popular_shows.description: Corporate worker Mikami Satoru is stabbed by a random killer, and is reborn to an alternate world. But he turns out to be reborn a slime! Thrown into this new world with the name Rimuru, he begins his quest to create a world that’s welcoming to all races.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Hulk Hogan: Real American
trakt_popular_shows.description: Before he was Hulk Hogan, he was Terry Bollea. Uncover the man behind the legend in this unfiltered documentary featuring his very last interview.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Quarterback
trakt_popular_shows.description: Follow the bruised bodies, soul-crushing fumbles, agonizing losses, and pure joy of three NFL quarterbacks during one season.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Owning Manhattan
trakt_popular_shows.description: Real estate mogul Ryan Serhant leads one of the biggest firms in New York and pushes his agents to greatness while tackling the most expensive listings.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Final Problem
trakt_popular_shows.description: In the spring of 1959, a retired actor, who previously played Sherlock Holmes, must investigate a murder at a small hotel on a tiny island near Mallorca.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Turn of the Tide
trakt_popular_shows.description: When a boat loaded with cocaine sinks off his home island, Eduardo sees a risky but exciting opportunity to make money and fulfill impossible dreams.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Completely Made-Up Adventures of Dick Turpin
trakt_popular_shows.description: Legendary highwayman Dick Turpin sets out on a series of wildly absurd escapades when he's made the reluctant leader of a band of outlaws—and tasked with outwitting utterly corrupt lawman Jonathan Wilde.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Sanctuary: A Witch's Tale
trakt_popular_shows.description: Set in a contemporary world where witchcraft is real, the story takes place in the idyllic English town of Sanctuary, where for hundreds of years witches have lived peacefully, as valued members of society. Until now…

trakt_popular_shows.name: Notes from the Last Row
trakt_popular_shows.description: A literature professor discovers a student's talent and offers him writing lessons — but as he sinks into the story, their sessions spiral into chaos.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On
trakt_popular_shows.description: Get hitched or call it quits? Couples put their love to the test — while shacking up with other potential matches — in a provocative reality series.

trakt_popular_shows.name: MOURINHO
trakt_popular_shows.description: This trophy-packed, insider-fuelled documentary charts José Mourinho's iconic rise as one of the world's top footballing managers of the most elite clubs.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Reasonable Doubt
trakt_popular_shows.description: In this legal drama, you’ll judge Jax Stewart for her questionable ethics and wild interpretations of the law… until you’re the one in trouble. Then you’ll see her for what she is: the most brilliant and fearless defense attorney in Los Angeles who bucks the justice system at every chance she gets.

trakt_popular_shows.name: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special
trakt_popular_shows.description: In a land dominated by the formidable Shadow Worlds, most of humanity has been destroyed. To rescue their planet from impending doom, six brave heroes fight a perilous battle…and fail. But there’s a glimpse of hope when Desir, one of the last mages, is suddenly sent back in time 13 years! Now armed with knowledge of the grim future, can he alter the course of history and save the world?

trakt_popular_shows.name: Flex x Cop
trakt_popular_shows.description: A chaebol cop joins forces with a gritty detective to take down criminals with a touch of wealth and a whole lot of wit.

trakt_popular_shows.name: High Tides
trakt_popular_shows.description: Over a tense summer on the Belgian coast, a wealthy friend group faces adulthood's harsh realities while grappling with love and societal expectations.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Prehistoric Planet
trakt_popular_shows.description: Experience the wonders of our world like never before in this epic series from Jon Favreau and the producers of Planet Earth. Travel back 66 million years to when majestic dinosaurs and extraordinary creatures roamed the lands, seas, and skies.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Neighborhood
trakt_popular_shows.description: The nicest guy in the Midwest moves his family into a tough neighborhood in Los Angeles where not everyone appreciates his extreme neighborliness. That includes their new next-door neighbor Calvin.

trakt_popular_shows.name: SkyMed
trakt_popular_shows.description: Life, death and drama at 20,000 feet. The series weaves together intense character journeys and high-stakes medical rescues, as we follow the triumphs, heartbreaks and tribulations of budding nurses and pilots flying air ambulances in remote Northern Canada. They’re all in over their heads, and on their own, with no one to rely on but each other.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Land of Sin
trakt_popular_shows.description: When a teenager goes missing, a detective with personal ties to the case joins a tense investigation that reveals fierce loyalties and old family feuds.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Ticket to Heaven
trakt_popular_shows.description: A grieving student pursuing priesthood faces a crisis of faith when he falls for a troubled new classmate in a world ruled by strict dogma.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Anatomy of a Moment
trakt_popular_shows.description: Madrid, Spain, February 23, 1981. A group of Civil Guards storm into the Congress of Deputies and terrorize those present by firing shots into the air. Only three men remain unmoved: Prime Minister Adolfo Suárez; Vice President Manuel Gutiérrez Mellado; and Santiago Carrillo, leader of the Communist Party.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Atasco
trakt_popular_shows.description: A major traffic jam throws thousands of citizens on the outskirts of Madrid into chaos, disrupting their plans. This everyday situation will be the starting point for unexpected, comical, and emotional plots.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Trigger Point
trakt_popular_shows.description: For London's bomb disposal experts, no day is ever the same as they risk their lives protecting the city from harm.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Unlocked: A Jail Experiment
trakt_popular_shows.description: At an Arkansas detention facility, a sheriff implements a radical social experiment to grant men who are incarcerated more agency in this reality series.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Ronaldinho: The One and Only
trakt_popular_shows.description: This series follows the life and career of Brazilian soccer star Ronaldinho, tracing his journey from young prodigy to global sports icon.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Vigil
trakt_popular_shows.description: The mysterious disappearance of a Scottish fishing trawler and a death on-board the submarine HMS Vigil bring the police into conflict with the Navy and British security services. DCI Amy Silva and DS Kirsten Longacre lead an investigation on land and at sea into a conspiracy that goes to the very heart of Britain’s national security.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Chestnut Man
trakt_popular_shows.description: At a grisly murder scene sits a figurine made of chestnuts. From this creepy clue, two detectives hunt a killer linked to a politician's missing child.

trakt_popular_shows.name: My Hero Academia
trakt_popular_shows.description: Izuku has dreamt of being a hero all his life—a lofty goal for anyone, but especially challenging for a kid with no superpowers. That’s right, in a world where eighty percent of the population has some kind of super-powered "quirk," Izuku was unlucky enough to be born completely normal. But that’s not enough to stop him from enrolling in one of the world’s most prestigious hero academies.

trakt_popular_shows.name: All the Truth in My Lies
trakt_popular_shows.description: Two roommates join a bachelorette road trip, where unspoken feelings ignite and shake up their entire friend group.

trakt_popular_shows.name: TRIGUN STAMPEDE
trakt_popular_shows.description: Vash the Stampede's a joyful gunslinging pacifist, so why does he have a $$6 million bounty on his head? That's what's puzzling rookie reporter Meryl Stryfe and her jaded veteran partner when looking into the vigilante only to find someone who hates blood.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten
trakt_popular_shows.description: Amane lives alone in an apartment, and the most beautiful girl in school, Mahiru, lives just next door. They've almost never spoken—until the day he sees her in distress on a rainy day and lends her his umbrella. To return the favour, she offers him help around the house, and a relationship slowly begins to blossom as the distance between them closes…

trakt_popular_shows.name: Kraken: The Black Book of Hours
trakt_popular_shows.description: A crime series based on the bestseller *The Black Book of Hours* by Eva García Sáenz de Urturi. Kraken receives a mysterious phone call ordering him to track down a rare, valuable book; if he fails, his mother will be killed. The problem, however, is that his mother has been dead for decades. Together with his inseparable partner Esti, he must solve a complex case filled with suspense, action, and emotion.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Terra alta
trakt_popular_shows.description: It centred on the murder of two prominent businesspeople in Catalonia.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Day One
trakt_popular_shows.description: Barcelona, 2026. During Mobile World Congress week, Ulises Albet, a former tech prodigy turned anti-tech activist, becomes the prime suspect in a murder. As he escapes through a city under lockdown, he uncovers the imminent launch of a groundbreaking technology that could put humanity's ethical future at risk. To stop it, he must confront his past.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Selling The OC
trakt_popular_shows.description: A fresh set of realtors square off, competing to establish themselves at The Oppenheim Group’s second office on the Orange County coast. Will the pressure prove too much for these agents to handle?

trakt_popular_shows.name: Aoashi
trakt_popular_shows.description: Ashito Aoi is a young, aspiring soccer player from a backwater town in Japan. His hopes of getting into a high school with a good soccer club are dashed when he causes an incident during a critical match for his team, which results in their loss and elimination from the tournament. Nevertheless, he catches the eye of someone important who happened to be visiting from Tokyo. How will things turn out for Ashito?

trakt_popular_shows.name: LOL : Qui rit, sort !
trakt_popular_shows.description: Philippe Lacheau has invited 10 actors and comedians to live a unique experience in a grandiose setting. There is only one rule to follow for the next 6 hours: if you laugh, you are eliminated. The 10 comedians will have to keep cool despite having to try and make each other laugh. The winner will get 50 000 euros for the charity he/she represents. Nothing is off limits!

trakt_popular_shows.name: Yakarta
trakt_popular_shows.description: José Ramón Garrido is a former Olympic badminton player who makes a living teaching physical education at a public high school in Vallecas. Divorced and without prospects, Joserra has been drifting for years, but he keeps himself afloat with a daily purpose. Joserra believes he has discovered the diamond that will turn his life around at a school tournament: Mar, a teenage player who could be his ticket to fulfilling his dream of competing in Jakarta, the city where former players like him are respected as stars. Joserra and Mar will have to learn to put up with each other on a journey full of dingy guesthouses, run-down sports centers, and gas stations that takes them through Totana, Ponferrada, Torrelavega, and Tardajos before they reach the Indonesian capital. That is, if they ever get there.

trakt_popular_shows.name: LOL: Chi ride è fuori
trakt_popular_shows.description: Is a comedy show where ten professional comedians face off for six hours in a row to keep a straight face, while they try to make their opponents laugh. The first time someone laughs the contestant gets warned, the second time, they get eliminated from the game. Whoever manages to resist without laughing all the way through the six hours wins EUR100,000 to turn over to the charity of their choice.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Crooks
trakt_popular_shows.description: A priceless coin forces a retired safecracker and a two-bit gangster to work together, drawing them into daring heists and global criminal rivalries.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Blood Coast
trakt_popular_shows.description: As a vicious drug dealer tries to overtake Marseille, a rogue police captain and his daredevil team welcome a new recruit with an agenda of her own.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Full Swing
trakt_popular_shows.description: This immersive documentary series follows a diverse group of professional golfers - on and off the course - during a relentless season of competition.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Skeleton Knight in Another World
trakt_popular_shows.description: One day, a gamer played video games until he fell asleep...and when he woke up, he found himself in the game world—as a skeleton! Equipped with the powerful weapons and armor of his avatar but stuck with its frightening skeletal appearance, Arc has to find a place for himself in this new, fantastical land. All his hopes for a quiet life are dashed when he crosses paths with a beautiful elven warrior, setting him on a journey full of conflict and adventure.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Pubertat
trakt_popular_shows.description: The harmony of a community is shattered by an allegation of sexual assault on social media that points to three teenagers as the main suspects.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Sin gluten
trakt_popular_shows.description: After hitting rock bottom, chef Ricardo fights against alcoholism. Forced to be in his old school, he will seek redemption by guiding talented students while dealing with a complicated attraction and his past. A path of second chances.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Smiling Friends
trakt_popular_shows.description: Smiling Friends Inc. is a small company whose main purpose is to bring happiness and make people smile. The series follows the day-to-day lives and misadventures of its representatives, the lazy, cynical Charlie, and the cheerful, optimistic Pim, as they try to cheer up and comfort the troubled people who call their company's hotline. They receive seemingly simple requests but the jobs turn out to be more complicated than they seem, making it difficult to bring happiness to the world.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Good Omens
trakt_popular_shows.description: Aziraphale and Crowley, of Heaven and Hell respectively, have grown rather fond of the Earth. So it's terrible news that it's about to end. The armies of Good and Evil are amassing. The Four Horsemen are ready to ride. Everything is going according to the Divine Plan...except that someone seems to have misplaced the Antichrist. Can our heroes find him and stop Armageddon before it's too late?

trakt_popular_shows.name: Punto Nemo
trakt_popular_shows.description: Members of an oceanographic expedition made up of scientists and the Spanish Navy embark on the Pentonkontors ship to investigate and raise awareness of the problems of the plastic island located in the South Pacific. It's time to get to grips with the situation and the freedom of the planet. It is important to know that your habitation for military personnel is good, so that you can prepare for your habitation and survival so that you can survive your daily life at Point Nemo. A place full of mysteries and lurking dangers.

trakt_popular_shows.name: All Creatures Great and Small
trakt_popular_shows.description: The heartwarming and humorous adventures of a young country vet in the Yorkshire Dales in the 1930s. A remake of the 1978 series.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Harry Wild
trakt_popular_shows.description: A recently retired English professor discovers a real knack for investigation and cannot help but interfere with the cases assigned to her police detective son.

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch
trakt_popular_shows.description: There is a ranch in northern Utah. It is considered the epicenter of the strangest, and most disturbing occurrences on Earth: For two decades, the federal government investigated the property. Their findings have never been made public. Now a new team of independent scientists and researchers are taking over. They are uncovering evidence that the countless stories, of unidentified aerial phenomena, Bizarre energies, and portals that lead to other dimensions Might actually be true. They will stop at nothing to reveal The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Rent-a-Girlfriend
trakt_popular_shows.description: Kinoshita Kazuya is a 20-year-old failure of a college student. He managed to kiss his girlfriend once, but was dumped after a month. Completely spiteful, Kazuya uses a certain method to date a girl. He goes to their meeting place and a beautiful girl brushing her long, black hair behind her ear was there, smiling at him. Her name was Mizuhara Chizuru. Something real is born after just a single rental! A reckless rom-com filled with love and excitement is about to begin!

trakt_popular_shows.name: The Predator of Seville
trakt_popular_shows.description: For years, Manuel Blanco was known among international students as “Manu White”, a friendly guide who organised cheap trips across Spain. But behind that image lay a far darker story. The case came to light when several young women began to connect experiences of abuse that had previously seemed unrelated.

trakt_popular_shows.name: Taxi Driver
trakt_popular_shows.description: A former special forces soldier delivers revenge for victims of injustice while working for a secret organization that fronts as a taxi company.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Coyote vs. Acme
trakt_watched_weekly.description: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: UNABOMBER
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The End of Oak Street
trakt_watched_weekly.description: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Runner
trakt_watched_weekly.description: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Love Hypothesis
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Uprising
trakt_watched_weekly.description: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Resident Evil
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Mayday
trakt_watched_weekly.description: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Toy Story 5
trakt_watched_weekly.description: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Backrooms
trakt_watched_weekly.description: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Insidious: Out of the Further
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn't just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realize her power, our world becomes their playground.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Obsession
trakt_watched_weekly.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Verity
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Lowen Ashleigh is hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who is unable to finish following an accident. Lowen gradually uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Digger
trakt_watched_weekly.description: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Fall 2: Deadpoint
trakt_watched_weekly.description: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Heart of the Beast
trakt_watched_weekly.description: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Soulm8te
trakt_watched_weekly.description: After a ruthless tech giant acquires a small robotics company, a grieving engineer is tasked with testing their new AI companion. But when he attempts to reprogram her to be a truly sentient soulmate, she develops needs of her own—unleashing a relentless spree of precision-engineered mayhem.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Project Hail Mary
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Odyssey
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Avengers: Endgame
trakt_watched_weekly.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
trakt_watched_weekly.description: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Disclosure Day
trakt_watched_weekly.description: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Invite
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Mutiny
trakt_watched_weekly.description: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Normal
trakt_watched_weekly.description: An unassuming substitute sheriff with a troubled past responds to a bank robbery in a small, sleepy town and unknowingly uncovers something far more explosive.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Supergirl
trakt_watched_weekly.description: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion on an epic, interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
trakt_watched_weekly.description: An ambitious director sets out to revive a faded slasher franchise, but her meeting with the film’s reclusive original star spirals into a terrifying maze of obsession, fear, and blood-soaked delusion.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Whisper Man
trakt_watched_weekly.description: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Mandalorian and Grogu
trakt_watched_weekly.description: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: One Night Only
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Moana
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Tuner
trakt_watched_weekly.description: A gifted piano tuner's meticulous skills for tuning pianos lead him to discover an unexpected aptitude for cracking safes, turning his life upside down.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Doing Life
trakt_watched_weekly.description: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Minions & Monsters
trakt_watched_weekly.description: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: In the Grey
trakt_watched_weekly.description: A covert team of elite operatives are living in the shadows. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, they're sent to take it back—an impossible heist that erupts into a deadly game of strategy, deception and survival.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Fix
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Colony
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Evil Dead Burn
trakt_watched_weekly.description: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Tony
trakt_watched_weekly.description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Avengers: Infinity War
trakt_watched_weekly.description: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Idiots
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Two rock-bottom drivers transport a wealthy teen to rehab, but their simple job spirals into a chaotic journey of drugs, danger, and crime as their passenger derails their plans.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Onslaught
trakt_watched_weekly.description: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
trakt_watched_weekly.description: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: It Ends
trakt_watched_weekly.description: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Harry Potter has lived under the stairs at his aunt and uncle's house his whole life. But on his 11th birthday, he learns he's a powerful wizard—with a place waiting for him at the Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. As he learns to harness his newfound powers with the help of the school's kindly headmaster, Harry uncovers the truth about his parents' deaths—and about the villain who's to blame.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Peter Parker is unmasked and no longer able to separate his normal life from the high-stakes of being a super-hero. When he asks for help from Doctor Strange the stakes become even more dangerous, forcing him to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Practical Magic
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Sally and Gillian Owens, born into a magical family, have mostly avoided witchcraft themselves. But when Gillian's vicious boyfriend, Jimmy Angelov, dies unexpectedly, the Owens sisters give themselves a crash course in hard magic. With policeman Gary Hallet growing suspicious, the girls struggle to resurrect Angelov -- and unwittingly inject his corpse with an evil spirit that threatens to end their family line.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Runner
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Devil Wears Prada 2
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Death of Robin Hood
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Deadpool & Wolverine
trakt_watched_weekly.description: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Having thwarted Bowser's previous plot to marry Princess Peach, Mario and Luigi now face a fresh threat in Bowser Jr., who is determined to liberate his father from captivity and restore the family legacy. Alongside companions new and old, the brothers travel across the stars to stop the young heir's crusade.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: One Last Shot
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Avengers
trakt_watched_weekly.description: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global safety and security, Nick Fury, director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D., finds himself in need of a team to pull the world back from the brink of disaster. Spanning the globe, a daring recruitment effort begins!

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Super Troopers 3
trakt_watched_weekly.description: When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Michael
trakt_watched_weekly.description: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Hokum
trakt_watched_weekly.description: When novelist Ohm Bauman retreats to a remote inn to scatter his parents' ashes, he is consumed by tales of a witch haunting the honeymoon suite. Disturbing visions and a shocking disappearance forces him to confront dark corners of his past.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Scary Movie
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Ice Cream Man
trakt_watched_weekly.description: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Drawn Together
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastian Moore as bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites in a world where nothing is as it seems.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Housemaid
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Trying to escape her past, Millie Calloway accepts a job as a live-in housemaid for the wealthy Nina and Andrew Winchester. But what begins as a dream job quickly unravels into something far more dangerous—a sexy, seductive game of secrets, scandal, and power.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Sheep Detectives
trakt_watched_weekly.description: George Hardy is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Weapons
trakt_watched_weekly.description: When all but one child from the same class mysteriously vanish on the same night at exactly the same time, a community is left questioning who or what is behind their disappearance.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Avengers: Age of Ultron
trakt_watched_weekly.description: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance. As the villainous Ultron emerges, it is up to The Avengers to stop him from enacting his terrible plans, and soon uneasy alliances and unexpected action pave the way for an epic and unique global adventure.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Interstellar
trakt_watched_weekly.description: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Spider-Man: Homecoming
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Following the events of Captain America: Civil War, Peter Parker, with the help of his mentor Tony Stark, tries to balance his life as an ordinary high school student in Queens, New York City, with fighting crime as his superhero alter ego Spider-Man as a new threat, the Vulture, emerges.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Cars fly, trees fight back, and a mysterious house-elf comes to warn Harry Potter at the start of his second year at Hogwarts. Adventure and danger await when bloody writing on a wall announces: The Chamber Of Secrets Has Been Opened. To save Hogwarts will require all of Harry, Ron and Hermione's magical abilities and courage.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Coraline
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Wandering her rambling old house in her boring new town, 11-year-old Coraline discovers a hidden door to a strangely idealized version of her life. In order to stay in the fantasy, she must make a frighteningly real sacrifice.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Masters of the Universe
trakt_watched_weekly.description: After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam back to Eternia, where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of Skeletor. To save his family and his world, Adam must join forces with his closest allies, Teela and Duncan/Man-At-Arms, and embrace his true destiny as He-Man — the most powerful man in the universe.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Hocus Pocus
trakt_watched_weekly.description: After 300 years of slumber, three sister witches are accidentally resurrected in Salem on Halloween night, and it is up to three kids and their newfound feline friend to put an end to the witches' reign of terror once and for all.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Primetime
trakt_watched_weekly.description: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Drama
trakt_watched_weekly.description: A happily engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Avatar: Fire and Ash
trakt_watched_weekly.description: In the wake of the devastating war against the RDA and the loss of their eldest son, Jake Sully and Neytiri face a new threat on Pandora: the Ash People, a violent and power-hungry Na'vi tribe led by the ruthless Varang. Jake's family must fight for their survival and the future of Pandora in a conflict that pushes them to their emotional and physical limits.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Iron Man
trakt_watched_weekly.description: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Captain America: Civil War
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Nightmare Before Christmas
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Tired of scaring humans every October 31 with the same old bag of tricks, Jack Skellington, the spindly king of Halloween Town, kidnaps Santa Claus and plans to deliver shrunken heads and other ghoulish gifts to children on Christmas morning. But as Christmas approaches, Jack's rag-doll girlfriend, Sally, tries to foil his misguided plans.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Pressure
trakt_watched_weekly.description: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Captain America: The First Avenger
trakt_watched_weekly.description: During World War II, Steve Rogers is a sickly man from Brooklyn who's transformed into super-soldier Captain America to aid in the war effort. Rogers must stop the Red Skull – Adolf Hitler's ruthless head of weaponry, and the leader of an organization that intends to use a mysterious device of untold powers for world domination.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Iron Man 2
trakt_watched_weekly.description: With the world now aware of his dual life as the armored superhero Iron Man, billionaire inventor Tony Stark faces pressure from the government, the press and the public to share his technology with the military. Unwilling to let go of his invention, Stark, with Pepper Potts and James 'Rhodey' Rhodes at his side, must forge new alliances – and confront powerful enemies.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Arkham Asylum has been destroyed, and all its inmates have been unleashed upon Gotham City. As Batman races to round up some of his greatest enemies, he is pushed to his physical and mental limits and into a final confrontation with a new threat: the man called Bane!

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Spider-Man: Far From Home
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Peter Parker and his friends go on a summer trip to Europe. However, they will hardly be able to rest - Peter will have to agree to help Nick Fury uncover the mystery of creatures that cause natural disasters and destruction throughout the continent.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Harry Potter's life is in danger once more as dangerous wizard Sirius Black has escaped from Azkaban Prison and is heading to Hogwarts.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Spa Weekend
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Dune: Part Two
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Thunderbolts*
trakt_watched_weekly.description: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, seven disillusioned castoffs must embark on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle
trakt_watched_weekly.description: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro, Nezuko, and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Best of the Best
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Two childhood besties join UCLA's competitive Bollywood-fusion dance team, only to find the road to the US championships is fiercer than they imagined.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
trakt_watched_weekly.description: A 'Man from the Future' arrives at an LA diner where he must recruit the precise combination of disgruntled patrons to join him on a one-night quest to save the world from the terminal threat of a rogue artificial intelligence.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Dune
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people. As malevolent forces explode into conflict over the planet's exclusive supply of the most precious resource in existence - a commodity capable of unlocking humanity's greatest potential - only those who can conquer their fear will survive.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Light years from Earth, 26 years after being abducted, Peter Quill finds himself the prime target of a manhunt after discovering an orb wanted by Ronan the Accuser.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Fantastic 4: First Steps
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Against the vibrant backdrop of a 1960s-inspired, retro-futuristic world, Marvel's First Family is forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, while defending Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic Herald, Silver Surfer.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Matrix
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Now You See Me: Now You Don't
trakt_watched_weekly.description: The original Four Horsemen reunite with a new generation of illusionists to take on powerful diamond heiress Veronika Vanderberg, who leads a criminal empire built on money laundering and trafficking. The new and old magicians must overcome their differences to work together on their most ambitious heist yet.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: The Last House
trakt_watched_weekly.description: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Mallorca confidencial
trakt_watched_weekly.description: Mallorca, 2007. La Chusa, the matriarch of a shantytown, runs the drug market with the support of neighbors, traffickers, and police. But when she suffers a massive robbery, she sees her power and her family shaken.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Iron Man 3
trakt_watched_weekly.description: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.

trakt_watched_weekly.name: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
