After moving into the mansion, Aoko Aozaki begins to learn sorcery from a young mage, Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. The Aozaki family oversees the land on which Misaki is built and the heir (Aoko) is tasked with protecting it. Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated. As this happens, both of them spot someone running away, a civilian who must not get away having seen magic alive. Unexpectedly, a young boy named Soujuurou Shizuki is drawn to the mansion and comes to reside with them as well.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Nightingale
trakt_anticipated.description: The lives of two French sisters are torn apart by the onset of World War II.

trakt_anticipated.name: Tenzing
trakt_anticipated.description: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

trakt_anticipated.name: John Rambo
trakt_anticipated.description: The origin story of a young John Rambo during the Vietnam War.

trakt_anticipated.name: Not Alone
trakt_anticipated.description: While preparing for a revolutionary space launch, an introverted rocket mechanic and a brilliant astro-botanist spark an unexpected romance—only for three runaway aliens to crash-land in his home, looking for a ride back to the stars.

trakt_anticipated.name: Josephine
trakt_anticipated.description: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault in Golden Gate Park, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice, and a way to feel safe again.

trakt_anticipated.name: Ramayana
trakt_anticipated.description: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

trakt_anticipated.name: Animal Friends
trakt_anticipated.description: Two fugitive animals embark on an adventure across America to find the ranch that was once their home, healing their friendship while pursued by an equally "odd-couple" DEA agent and Fish and Wildlife ranger with something to prove.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Debut
trakt_anticipated.description: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

trakt_anticipated.name: Zero A.D: The Birth of Christ
trakt_anticipated.description: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

trakt_anticipated.name: Club Kid
trakt_anticipated.description: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Cycle
trakt_anticipated.description: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.

trakt_anticipated.name: Kaamelott: The Second Chapter (Part II)
trakt_anticipated.description: Third and final film in the Kaamelott franchise.

trakt_anticipated.name: Rage of Stars
trakt_anticipated.description: A story about a woman from the International Special Forces Unit, who has a premonition about the impending end of humanity.

trakt_anticipated.name: Behemoth!
trakt_anticipated.description: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

trakt_anticipated.name: Breeder
trakt_anticipated.description: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

trakt_anticipated.name: Ink
trakt_anticipated.description: A group of misfits and visionaries had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Conjuring: First Communion
trakt_anticipated.description: A prequel in the franchise. Plot TBA.

trakt_anticipated.name: Ali G: Who Iz I?
trakt_anticipated.description: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

trakt_anticipated.name: Masterplan
trakt_anticipated.description: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him before revealing they are long-lost siblings… and oh yes, by the way, he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

trakt_anticipated.name: Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi
trakt_anticipated.description: Sequel to Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Great Beyond
trakt_anticipated.description: An author of popular fantasy novels discovers that the mythical world he’s known for creating is actually real.

trakt_anticipated.name: Beware Boiúna
trakt_anticipated.description: Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiúna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Mosquito Bowl
trakt_anticipated.description: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four US college football stars enlist in the Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

trakt_anticipated.name: Musk
trakt_anticipated.description: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world’s most heralded "inventor-entrepreneur" who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.

trakt_anticipated.name: F.A.S.T.
trakt_anticipated.description: A former special forces commando, down on his luck after returning Stateside, is recruited by the DEA to lead a covert black ops team to take down CIA-protected drug dealers.

trakt_anticipated.name: Way of the Warrior Kid
trakt_anticipated.description: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Rescue
trakt_anticipated.description: A former rodeo cowboy takes matters into his own hands when his daughter is kidnapped for ransom. With her devoted dog by his side, he sets out to bring her home and will stop at nothing to find her.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Red Queen
trakt_anticipated.description: A young software engineer ventures into a vivid journey to study a newly developed A.I. interface.

trakt_anticipated.name: Anything but Ghosts
trakt_anticipated.description: When a group of fame-seeking wannabe "ghosthunters" find themselves in over their heads, things spiral wildly and terrifyingly out of control.

trakt_anticipated.name: Mr. Irrelevant
trakt_anticipated.description: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Gallerist
trakt_anticipated.description: A desperate gallerist conspires to sell a dead body at Art Basel Miami.

trakt_anticipated.name: Hershey
trakt_anticipated.description: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s orphans.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Bluey Movie
trakt_anticipated.description: On an action-packed day, a big surprise changes everything for Bluey and her family.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Beast
trakt_anticipated.description: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

trakt_anticipated.name: Paranormal Activity 8
trakt_anticipated.description: The eighth installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

trakt_anticipated.name: A Talent for Murder
trakt_anticipated.description: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Third Parent
trakt_anticipated.description: A neighborhood Fourth of July celebration is interrupted by a ferociously bizarre anomaly who overpowers a family in order to teach them how to become better people and more compliant citizens.

trakt_anticipated.name: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
trakt_anticipated.description: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

trakt_anticipated.name: Untitled Ocean's Prequel
trakt_anticipated.description: Follows Danny Ocean's parents, two masterminds, as they pull off an elaborate heist at the 1962 Monaco Grand Prix.

trakt_anticipated.name: Panic Carefully
trakt_anticipated.description: Described as a paranoid thriller about a hunt for a cyber-terrorist in the vein of Mr. Robot and The Silence of the Lambs.

trakt_anticipated.name: Coward
trakt_anticipated.description: Pierre, a young Belgian soldier, wants to prove himself on the battlefield during the First World War. Behind the frontlines, he meets Francis, who is asked to find a way to boost morale.

trakt_anticipated.name: Crawlers
trakt_anticipated.description: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

trakt_anticipated.name: Minotaur
trakt_anticipated.description: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

trakt_anticipated.name: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend
trakt_anticipated.description: Faced with the truth about Miori and Touko Kirishima, Sakuta must make a choice. This will be his final case of Adolescence Syndrome!

trakt_anticipated.name: Shiver
trakt_anticipated.description: A ne'er-do-well smuggler finds himself in the middle of a deadly double-cross while on a job in the Caribbean Sea, resulting in him getting surrounded by bodies, hostile mercenaries and thirsty sharks alike, all while stuck in a deathly time loop and scrambling to break the cycle.

trakt_anticipated.name: Jason Statham Stole My Bike
trakt_anticipated.description: Jason Statham in the role of a lifetime, playing global action superstar Jason Statham. Plot TBA.

trakt_anticipated.name: King
trakt_anticipated.description: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Fox
trakt_anticipated.description: An affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancée into the perfect woman.

trakt_anticipated.name: Maserati: The Brothers
trakt_anticipated.description: Chronicles the Maserati family's journey, from its founding in 1914 to becoming a renowned Italian luxury car manufacturer, alongside rivals Ferrari and Lamborghini.

trakt_anticipated.name: Misty Green
trakt_anticipated.description: Years after her Hollywood breakthrough, a talented actress whose career has stalled fights for her second act.

trakt_anticipated.name: Beach Read
trakt_anticipated.description: When an idealistic romance novelist and a cynical literary fiction writer—rival authors with dramatically opposing worldviews and a serious case of writer's block—unexpectedly find themselves living next door to each other in a small Lake Michigan beach town for the summer, they strike an unlikely bet to swap genres and the lines between fiction and romance begin to blur.

trakt_anticipated.name: Eternal Return
trakt_anticipated.description: Cass has come to a personal point of emotional invulnerability, until she meets Virgil, a cartographer. Along with his partner Malcolm, they attempt to travel back in time to awaken Cass to love again.

trakt_anticipated.name: Vāranāsi
trakt_anticipated.description: Follows Rudhra's perilous adventures as ancient Varanasi stands on the brink of catastrophe from a looming asteroid in 2027 CE, unfolding across multiple timelines and distant continents.

trakt_anticipated.name: Jimmy
trakt_anticipated.description: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

trakt_anticipated.name: Flavia
trakt_anticipated.description: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.

trakt_anticipated.name: Everybody Wants to F*ck Me
trakt_anticipated.description: Adam strives to present as a sensitive feminist but behind the facade he’s a serial womaniser. After a one night stand with a mysterious stranger leaves him suddenly irresistible, Adam’s dream quickly turns into a nightmare.

trakt_anticipated.name: Elsinore
trakt_anticipated.description: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

trakt_anticipated.name: Steps
trakt_anticipated.description: Think you know Cinderella's 'evil' stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

trakt_anticipated.name: Nightmare Hospital
trakt_anticipated.description: A horror film about a pilot who is the sole survivor of the plane crash in the deep unknown. He must survive in an isolated building where something evil is waiting.

trakt_anticipated.name: From the Ashes
trakt_anticipated.description: Jailed for her husband's crime, a woman discovers that her only way out is to solve riddles from her mysterious past.

trakt_anticipated.name: Bad Lieutenant: Tokyo
trakt_anticipated.description: A corrupt gambler in the Metropolitan Police Force finds himself thrown into a tangled case after an enigmatic FBI agent arrives in Tokyo to investigate the disappearance of a politician’s daughter.

trakt_anticipated.name: Pendulum
trakt_anticipated.description: A couple, journeys to a retreat in New Mexico seeking healing. Patrick grows skeptical of the retreat's leader as Abigail falls under her influence. They wonder if the group's practices offer genuine healing or conceal a terrifying truth.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Last Temptation of Becky
trakt_anticipated.description: Now working as a field agent for the CIA, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf's Lair, Hitler's WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Comeback King
trakt_anticipated.description: A country western star experiences a dramatic downfall and must navigate their career in free fall.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Haunting of Hotel Transylvania
trakt_anticipated.description: Drac has happily settled into retirement while Mavis takes the reins of the legendary monster hotel. But when a series of spooky and unexplained happenings sends chills through the resort, the Drac Pack embarks on its most spellbinding adventure yet: uncovering the mystery behind the haunting of Hotel Transylvania.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Revenge of La Llorona
trakt_anticipated.description: A grieving mother's ancient curse targets a troubled family, forcing them to confront their own hidden past while fighting to survive her supernatural wrath.

trakt_anticipated.name: Wishful Thinking
trakt_anticipated.description: Julia, an ambitious game designer, and Charlie, a struggling musician, are at a loss for how to repair their volatile relationship. After attending a couples-therapy seminar run by mysterious twin healers, they find that the ups-and-downs of their relationship have supernatural effects on the world around them. With earthquakes, the stock market, and entire nations at risk, Charlie and Julia must confront whether their passionate love can survive amidst so much chaos.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Florist
trakt_anticipated.description: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

trakt_anticipated.name: Untitled Blair Witch Film
trakt_anticipated.description: A family goes on a camping trip and goes missing one by one after they hear strange noises in the forest.

trakt_anticipated.name: Drive - The Pretenders
trakt_anticipated.description: A young race car mechanic fakes an engagement to the most scandalous racing star on the scene—officially for his reputation, secretly for her own chance behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything, including what has long since become more than just a game.

trakt_anticipated.name: V/H/S/Mixtape
trakt_anticipated.description: V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the volume on horror with a blood-soaked collection of cursed music videos, terrifying performances, and found footage. Press play. Pray it stops.

trakt_anticipated.name: GROTESQQQUE
trakt_anticipated.description: Anthology film made up of 3 separate segments: ÆLIENS, YOROSHIKU★Girl, and NOCTURNE: NUIT GROTESQUE.

trakt_anticipated.name: Angel and the Badman
trakt_anticipated.description: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.

trakt_anticipated.name: Air Bud Returns
trakt_anticipated.description: 12-year-old Jacob is an aspiring basketball player coping with the recent loss of his father. After he and his mother move to his dad’s childhood home in Fernfield, Jacob discovers a VHS tape of his old man playing basketball on the same court as a hoops-shooting golden retriever. Soon, Jacob begins his own adventure with a neglected golden retriever that he names Buddy.

trakt_anticipated.name: Bunker
trakt_anticipated.description: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife of 17 years begins to question their relationship.

trakt_anticipated.name: Lilo & Scratch
trakt_anticipated.description: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

trakt_anticipated.name: Drag
trakt_anticipated.description: A routine robbery at a rural house turns into a nightmare for two amateur burglars when one of them throws their back out. Things spiral out of control as they try to make it out before the homeowner returns.

trakt_anticipated.name: Pierre the Pigeon-Hawk
trakt_anticipated.description: In New York City, Pierre, born as a product of forbidden love between a hawk and a pigeon, is rejected by both communities. Tired of not fitting in, Pierre sets out on a mission to discover where he truly belongs.

trakt_anticipated.name: Being Heumann
trakt_anticipated.description: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

trakt_anticipated.name: Clean Hands
trakt_anticipated.description: The true story of hero drug cop turned recovery advocate Kevin Simmers and his daughter Brooke. The film examines the American drug crisis and "the thin blue line" from the opposing eyes of cop and addict who were also father and daughter.

trakt_anticipated.name: Jailer 2
trakt_anticipated.description: Following the events of "Jailer", former ruthless police officer Muthuvel Pandian must come face-to-face with the consequences of his actions against the antique mafia.

trakt_anticipated.name: November 1963
trakt_anticipated.description: Follows the 48 hours after the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, the alleged involvement of Sam Giancana and the 'Chicago Outfit', and a supposed broken promise after the mob helped to get Kennedy elected.

trakt_anticipated.name: Animol
trakt_anticipated.description: Behind the walls of a young offender institution, Troy is thrust into a brutal world of gangs, loyalty and violence from the moment he arrives. When an unspoken bond develops with a fellow inmate, it becomes a dangerous vulnerability for them.

trakt_anticipated.name: You Can't Leave
trakt_anticipated.description: James searches for answers behind his sister's mysterious disappearance. His journey leads him and a group of friends deep into a remote forest where they become trapped in a supernatural prison. Hunted by shadowy entities, the group is forced to confront both physical and psychological terror as they struggle to escape

trakt_anticipated.name: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
trakt_anticipated.description: Lindsey and her extended family head to Walt Disney World to spend a magical Christmas together, but the dream of a jolly holiday gets quickly dashed when Lindsey discovers her room is next door to Philip, a disastrous first date she recently had, who’s also there on a family trip. As Lindsey and Philip’s paths cross throughout their stay, the frost starts to thaw as they learn they’re not so different from each other after all. Thanks to some Walt Disney World magic, the holiday wish Lindsey made in Cinderella Fountain just might turn their rivalry into romance.

trakt_anticipated.name: Guarding Stars
trakt_anticipated.description: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

trakt_anticipated.name: Baahubali: The Eternal War – Part 1
trakt_anticipated.description: The murdered Prince Baahubali enters the afterlife and joins an eternal war across 14 realms between Devas and Asuras – personifications of Order and Chaos. His destiny will reshape the cosmos forever.

trakt_anticipated.name: Possession
trakt_anticipated.description: A remake of Andrzej Zulawski's 1981 cult horror. Plot TBA.

trakt_anticipated.name: Anxious People
trakt_anticipated.description: On the day before Christmas Eve, investment banker Zara begrudgingly finds herself mingling with a group of strangers at an open house. When a reluctant bank robber inadvertently takes the group hostage, chaos and oversharing ensues, secrets are revealed and literally nothing goes according to plan

trakt_anticipated.name: Big Girls Don't Cry
trakt_anticipated.description: Over one transformative summer in rural New Zealand in 2006, 14-year-old Sid discovers desire, identity, and the internet as she imitates the people she longs to be loved by.

trakt_anticipated.name: Moulin
trakt_anticipated.description: In June 1943, Jean Moulin, leader of the French Resistance, is arrested while attempting to reunite the forces of the "Armée Secrète." Interrogated by Klaus Barbie, the head of the Gestapo in Lyon, Moulin is drawn into a relentless confrontation.

trakt_anticipated.name: A Place in Hell
trakt_anticipated.description: A top criminal defense attorney, known for representing unlikeable clients in high-profile cases, is a relentless workhorse at her firm and fully expects to be named partner. When another attorney joins the firm, her job is put to the test and makes her question just how far she’ll go to protect it.

trakt_anticipated.name: Les Misérables
trakt_anticipated.description: After enduring 19 years in prison for stealing a loaf of bread, Jean Valjean emerges a hardened man. He seeks redemption by reinventing himself as a respected dignitary under a new identity. He promises Fantine, a dying factory worker, to rescue and protect her daughter Cosette, who is being exploited and mistreated by the deceitful Thénardier family. As Valjean raises Cosette as his own, he is relentlessly pursued by Inspector Javert. Admist the social unrest shaking France, the fates of Valjean, Cosette, her lover Marius, and Javert become intertwined in a turbulent, revolutionary Paris. Through struggles, sacrifices, and a deep yearning for justice, Valjean strives to complete his journey of redemption and offer Cosette a future of love and freedom.

trakt_anticipated.name: Free at Heart
trakt_anticipated.description: Sebastian's (16) sheltered small-town life changes suddenly when his family takes in 15-year-old Kolja, supposedly the son of his father's recently deceased girlfriend. In addition to his little sister, another teenager now lives with them. Although the two boys are strangers to each other at first, they begin to open up to each other more and more and discover that they are biological brothers. The relationship of trust with his parents breaks down and when Sebastian and Kolja become closer than they expected, Sebastian's life is suddenly turned upside down, as he has found not only a soul mate in his new brother, but also a real, first love. Overwhelmed by their feelings, the two hide their relationship, but when the secret, incestuous relationship is discovered, the family breaks out of the social structure of the small town and comes into conflict with societal norms. Everything that follows is a rollercoaster of emotions.

trakt_anticipated.name: Black Church Bay
trakt_anticipated.description: In a sleepy Welsh fishing village, Barry’s life starts to unravel after an intimate encounter with a younger man.

trakt_anticipated.name: Heartland
trakt_anticipated.description: A former country star, Misty Jones, comes out of seclusion to investigate the disappearance of her missing niece, a rising country musician and must grapple with her own past and Nashville’s seedy underbelly. Her search uncovers a murky side of Nashville where no one, including Misty, is who they seem.

trakt_anticipated.name: I See Buildings Fall Like Lightning
trakt_anticipated.description: Childhood friends Patrick, Shiv, Rian, Oli, and Conor played together, skipped school together, and dreamt of the lives they would have one day. Now they’re thirty, and the future they imagined is slipping quietly out of reach.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
trakt_anticipated.description: A collection of rogues must gather information on a mysterious extra-dimensional threat to the galaxy in the 43rd century, and prepare a defense while fending off the first wave of attacks from horrific beings.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Saviors
trakt_anticipated.description: A suburban couple whose life spirals out of control when they rent their garage to mysterious tenants.

trakt_anticipated.name: If I Were You 3
trakt_anticipated.description: Two decades after their last body swap, Cláudio and Helena are living a new phase of their lives alongside their daughter Bia, now an adult and married with Aquiles. Everything seems balanced until an unexpected situation shakes up the family dynamic and puts their relationships to the test. When lightning seems to strike the same place again, the whole family is forced to learn to put themselves in each other's shoes, in a very literal way.

trakt_anticipated.name: Apocalypse Z: New World
trakt_anticipated.description: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.

trakt_anticipated.name: Deathgasm 2: Goremageddon
trakt_anticipated.description: After failing to reform his heavy metal band DEATHGASM for a battle-of-the-bands to win back his girlfriend Medina, Brodie decides to use black magic to raise his ex-band members Zakk and Dion from the dead. However, his resurrected friends become unpredictable and dangerous, leading to chaos in the town.

trakt_anticipated.name: Let's Have Kids!
trakt_anticipated.description: Two best friends, Emma and Phoebe, decide to get pregnant simultaneously to navigate motherhood together, but their friendship is tested when only one of them conceives.

trakt_anticipated.name: Someone Dies Tonight
trakt_anticipated.description: A group of friends sets out on a holiday road trip to Greece. On their way south, they are intercepted by a group of Croatian gangsters. Locked in a remote house, they find themselves struggling for their lives.

trakt_anticipated.name: La Gradiva
trakt_anticipated.description: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.

trakt_anticipated.name: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
trakt_anticipated.description: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

trakt_anticipated.name: Bokshi
trakt_anticipated.description: Anahita, traumatised by the brutal disappearance of her mother, finds comfort in Shalini, her history teacher. On an unconventional school excursion to a mysterious prehistoric site, she confronts her terrifying destiny.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Last Druid
trakt_anticipated.description: A ruthless Roman emperor discovers a secluded Druid stronghold in the mountains of Caledonia, the last remnant of the mystical tribe. When the imperial legions threaten to annihilate the ancient civilization, a peaceful Celtic elder is forced to betray his vow of pacifism and to take up arms to defend his family from the inexorable advance of the Empire in a clash that will decide the fate of an entire culture.

trakt_anticipated.name: ghost - end of night
trakt_anticipated.description: I want to know what is ＜real＞. Set in the near future where labor is no longer necessary, this is the story of Neekei, a girl who continues seeking the “real” while resisting the order of a content society.

trakt_anticipated.name: A Long Winter
trakt_anticipated.description: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

trakt_anticipated.name: Iron Boy
trakt_anticipated.description: In rural France, Christophe (10) tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner... A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?

trakt_anticipated.name: Family Movie
trakt_anticipated.description: The Smiths have gathered once again on their quaint family farm to make the latest in a string of low-budget horror movies. No, the movies aren't particularly "successful." Some might even call them "bad." But at least the family is together, and that's what matters to Jack and Ellen. Their adult children, on the other hand - Trent and Ula - are working up the courage to leave this particular family tradition behind. Simmering family dysfunction turns to pure chaos when a real dead body shows up on set. Can they come together to keep the movie on track, or will this be the Smith family's final act?

trakt_anticipated.name: The Surgeon
trakt_anticipated.description: A former surgeon is kidnapped and given an impossible choice.

trakt_anticipated.name: Christmas at the Kringles
trakt_anticipated.description: The Severson family move to a suburban neighborhood where their next-door neighbors, the Kringles, celebrate Christmas year-round. But when their son becomes increasingly attached to the unusual family, Mark and Julie begin to suspect that their neighbors aren't quite what they seem.

trakt_anticipated.name: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
trakt_anticipated.description: A powerful return to roots, this concert captures Black Sabbath in peak form - reuniting to deliver classic hits with raw energy and legendary precision.

trakt_anticipated.name: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
trakt_anticipated.description: Built entirely from archival footage, personal photos, and rare home videos contributed by fans and friends, Norm tell his own story in his own voice.

trakt_anticipated.name: Crawl 2
trakt_anticipated.description: Chaos is unleashed when animals from New York's Central Park Zoo escape during a violent storm, posing a new and unpredictable danger to survivors.

trakt_anticipated.name: Species
trakt_anticipated.description: Margot, a young intern at the country's most competitive ER, struggles in the high-pressure environment. When multiple patients her age arrive with strange symptoms, her own body begins experiencing alarming transformations.

trakt_anticipated.name: Slayground
trakt_anticipated.description: On the week of Halloween, the primary suspect in a mass murder investigation escapes police custody and goes on the run, attempting to prove his innocence while becoming the target of a massive manhunt.

trakt_anticipated.name: Hallowarrior
trakt_anticipated.description: Pumpkin, the last girl on earth and sole survivor of a humanity-ending plague, scavenging the wasteland for supplies on the eve of Halloween. Pumpkin’s lonely holiday ritual is interrupted by the arrival of a savage gang of raiders at her doorstep, led by the fearsome Thalia. Outnumbered and armed with candy, wit and weapons, Pumpkin must ferociously fight back to survive the night.

trakt_anticipated.name: Dragon
trakt_anticipated.description: Set in 1967 around International Opium Trade by Afghan Trading Company and Golden Trading Company

trakt_anticipated.name: The Hunchback: Soul of Paris
trakt_anticipated.description: As cholera threatens to ravage the city of Paris in 1830, a hunchback hunted for medical experiments is caught between political turmoil and impossible love.

trakt_anticipated.name: Bad Day
trakt_anticipated.description: A single mom fights to keep one little promise to her daughter on the absolute worst day of her life.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Spiral
trakt_anticipated.description: On a stormy night in Rome, Anna arrives at her daughter Alice’s apartment with a devastating confession: their entire family history is built on a lie. Twenty years earlier, after a horrific accident that nearly cost Alice her leg, Anna claims she made a pact with a mysterious Stranger to save her. But the miracle came at a price. What she believed was a single desperate bargain has in fact unleashed a spiraling chain reaction — a domino effect of increasingly dark events that have haunted their lives ever since. Now, the Stranger has come to collect. And Anna is convinced that only Alice can break the spiral and set things right. But at what cost?

trakt_anticipated.name: Tender Loving Care
trakt_anticipated.description: Amy is a devoted social service worker who puts her heart and soul into her job to care for those in need. At home, however, she finds herself confronting new challenges as her beloved father begins to show the early signs of dementia, and she and her mother must begin to make peace with their new reality. Through it all, Amy finds comfort, perspective, and plenty of laughter through sips of wine with her lifelong friend Rosie, whose warmth and wit become a vital anchor as both women navigate the shifting rhythms of approaching middle age.

trakt_anticipated.name: Gugu's World
trakt_anticipated.description: Gugu, a black boy living with his grandmother, experiences memories and revelations when the old city where she lived returns.

trakt_anticipated.name: Orphans
trakt_anticipated.description: A ruthless con artist targets a wealthy European household, but her calculated scheme hits an unexpected snag when someone discovers her dark past and vows to expose her true identity.

trakt_anticipated.name: In a Holidaze
trakt_anticipated.description: After making a romantic mistake of epic proportions, an aimless twentysomething finds herself trapped in a holiday time-loop, forced to relive the same Christmas at her family’s cabin until she discovers what truly makes her happy.

trakt_anticipated.name: Prima Facie
trakt_anticipated.description: Tessa is a brilliant British defence barrister dominating London’s ruthless courtrooms. Fierce, witty, and self-made, she defends men accused of sexual assault — until she is assaulted herself by a colleague from a powerful legal dynasty. Suddenly, the system she trusted turns against her. As she faces the same tactics she once used in court, Tessa’s faith in justice unravels. Once in control, now exposed and disbelieved, she must fight to reclaim her voice and sense of self.

trakt_anticipated.name: Father Joe
trakt_anticipated.description: Set in 1990s Manhattan, the film will see Sutherland play a priest who declares a one-man war on the city’s criminal underworld. Pacino steps into the role of a powerful mob boss whose empire collides with Father Joe’s violent crusade, while Anderson plays a young woman caught between danger and redemption under the priest’s protection.

trakt_anticipated.name: Forty Love
trakt_anticipated.description: Sacha Gallo, a tennis prodigy, has been training with his father to win a major trophy in Paris. But the arrival of a charismatic new rival challenges everything Sacha thought he understood about competition, ambition, and himself.

trakt_anticipated.name: Everest: The Other Side
trakt_anticipated.description: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.

trakt_anticipated.name: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
trakt_anticipated.description: The life of Dr. Sandeep Kapoor was turned upside down when he's implicated in the wrongful death trial of one-time Playboy centerfold Anna Nicole Smith.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Liberation
trakt_anticipated.description: Rita is entranced by the mesmeric Leader and renounces her family to embrace the world of the enigmatic Harmonia commune. Her daughters Ella and Jo put everything on the line to infiltrate the cult and bring their mother home. Yet, once immersed in the commune, they find themselves inexorably drawn into the Leader’s labyrinthine web of psycho-spiritual manipulation.

trakt_anticipated.name: River
trakt_anticipated.description: After being stranded in a boat on a country river, three siblings are stalked by a faceless killer.

trakt_anticipated.name: Falling
trakt_anticipated.description: Jack, while quick-witted, charming, and avoidant, finally risks opening his heart when he starts dating Jillian. He never expected, though, that his best friend Johnny would fall for her, too.

trakt_anticipated.name: The Blood Countess
trakt_anticipated.description: The Blood Countess and her maid embark on a quest for the red elixir of life and a book that threatens the vampire realm. Hot on their heels are a police inspector, two vampirologists, a vegetarian nephew and his therapist.

trakt_boxoffice.name: Verity
trakt_boxoffice.description: Lowen Ashleigh is hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who is unable to finish following an accident. Lowen gradually uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.

trakt_boxoffice.name: Resident Evil
trakt_boxoffice.description: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

trakt_boxoffice.name: Heart of the Beast
trakt_boxoffice.description: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

trakt_boxoffice.name: Primetime
trakt_boxoffice.description: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.

trakt_boxoffice.name: Digger
trakt_boxoffice.description: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

trakt_boxoffice.name: Forgotten Island
trakt_boxoffice.description: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

trakt_boxoffice.name: Avengers: Endgame
trakt_boxoffice.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.

trakt_boxoffice.name: Drishyam: The Conclusion
trakt_boxoffice.description: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

trakt_boxoffice.name: Practical Magic 2
trakt_boxoffice.description: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

trakt_boxoffice.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
trakt_boxoffice.description: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
